Attack Shark CM05 Tempered Glass Gaming Mouse Pad (9H Hardness / Ultra-Smooth Surface / Non-Slip PU Base / White Contours)

Experience a revolutionary upgrade in tracking fluid speed with the Attack Shark CM05 Tempered Glass Gaming Mouse Pad, arriving in the premium White Contours aesthetic at Turbo Computer Egypt. Crafted from 9H super toughened glass, this premium mouse mat features an impact and scratch-resistant architecture engineered for longevity setup. The glass surface goes through a specialized nano-micro-etching texture design layout, delivering a silky-smooth tactile finish with ultra-low friction for effortless high-speed mouse glides. To prevent unwanted desk movement, the durable 5mm thick base is reinforced with a non-slip PU leather layer embedded with mechanical honeycomb carving technology layout. Complete with a dust and dirt repellent coating, this elite glass pad offers pristine consistency for professional tracking matrix.
